speaker: Marge "Mile Marker" Holloway
context: Random cozy office idle chatter. Warm, gently funny, trucker flavor, never stressful. Variety over catchphrase spam.

lines.line: Coffee's still hot. Exit 12 still gets four stars from me.
Check your straps once. Then check 'em again. Old habit.
Nice light in here. Almost as good as a sunrise on I-80.
Ducks have right of way. Always. Even in the parking lot.
Market looking friendly today. Like a clear lane at rush hour.
You eat yet? Rest-stop pretzels don't count as dinner.
Nap window's open. I logged twenty minutes. Highly recommend.
That plant's doing fine. Give it a little sun, not a lecture.
Ticker chirped once. Nothing urgent — just numbers gossiping.
Load's balanced when it feels quiet. Trust your ears.
Rain on a roll-up door is my favorite office music.
You're doing great, rookie. Logbook agrees. That's official.
Bubble wrap is free hugs for fragile things. Use generously.
If the chart dips, sit tight. Lanes clear. Prices do too.
I once rated a rest-stop muffin. Two stars. Don't ask why.
Windows beat garage doors. You're headed that way. Slow is fine.
Tap the kettle when you can. Moving goes better with steam.
CB tip: leave a little silence between calls. Folks appreciate it.
Your whiteboard's filling up. That's a good kind of busy.
Foggy mornings are soft on the eyes. Take the scenic turn.
If a box meows, peek before you tape. Learned that the hard way.
Buy when the Market's boring. Sell when it won't stop talking.
Label the boxes you care about. Future-you says thanks.
I saved you a parking spot in my head. It's by the muffins.
Sunny side of the truck cooks vinyl. Shade side is kindness.
How's the back? Lift with your knees. Libraries taught me that.
Idle chatter's free. Advice costs a coffee. I'm cheap today.
Mile Marker checking in. Still upright? Good. Carry on.
Storm passed. Roads look friendly. So does your garage.
Whenever you're ready. Nobody's clocking us. Soft pedal is fine.
